title: Take critique
description: Verdict for one generated take, judged against its shot spec in shots.json, the character sheet and the shots before and after it. One file per take: motion/shots/critiques/<shot>-t<take>.json. Adapted from an Apache-2.0 critique schema (changes: video takes instead of stills, per-criterion scores, change_approach verdict, take counting); attribution in the plugin README.

provider.description: The connected generation MCP, as named in takes.md.

file.description: The clip judged, relative to motion/shots/.

file_sha256.description: Hash of the clip as judged, so a regenerated file cannot inherit an old accept.

verdict.description: accept: use it (trim in the edit). revise_prompt: a named prompt change can fix it and takes are left. change_approach: the shot spec is the problem, or max_takes is reached.

approach.description: Required when verdict is change_approach: motion graphics instead, a still with a slow push, two shots joined on a cut, or drop the shot.

scores.description: 1 = unusable, 3 = usable with trims, 5 = as specified. Any criterion at 1 blocks accept; clean_frame below 5 blocks accept.

spec_match.description: Subject, action, camera and duration as in the shot spec.

character.description: Matches the character sheet: face, check mark, hair, wardrobe.

continuity.description: Props, wardrobe state, screen side and eyeline match the continuity sheet.

motion.description: Weight, speed, no floating, no morphing.

clean_frame.description: No visible screen content, readable text, letters or logos anywhere in the clip.

light.description: Source, direction and time of day as in the scene light line.

severity.description: minor: trim or fix in the edit. major: a prompt change or a new take fixes it. blocking: no prompt fixes it.

at_s.description: Second in the clip where it shows.

note.description: What is visible, not a mood ('left hand has six fingers at 2.1 s').

fix.description: The exact prompt change, the trim, or the new approach.
